verdict.tagline: Endless sandbox creativity powered entirely by community mods.
for_you_if: you enjoy building and experimenting in sandbox environments
you play with friends in multiplayer servers
not_for_you_if: you want a complete standalone game out of the box
you are unwilling to download workshop mods and texture packs

citations.review_text: This game is very fun to mess around in by yourself, or with friends. The community made maps, addons, and player models are really cool. I would recommend this over VRChat because of the creativity and better fanbase tbh. Also, if you play in a public server, please be patient, because it requires to you download any addons that the server has enabled, and it can take a while. Overall, this is a fun game and is worth the money. I like messing around with ragdolls they so funni.

claims.claim: The game's mechanics and controls are described as tricky or taking time to learn.

citations.review_text: Extremely creative, i havent figured out most of the controls yet, but i LOVE the game in all of its glory.

Well, I first heard of the game in the year 2024 when my uncle was living with my family and me. I asked my uncle what the game was about, and he said the game was about and he replied you can add props, vehicles, and NPS's. He showed me how you could make the NPCs fight to the death. My uncle also showed me that you can download different maps and NPCs. Now in 2026, I have downloaded the game myself and experienced lots of fun. Overall, I would 100 percent recommend the game to any person. However, the game's mechanics are a little tricky to get a hold of.
It is a good game if you wanna pose TF2 models. It does take some time to learn the mechanics of using the GMod posing, but you can create some stuff with the right TF2 models.

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Long term players highlight that public servers lean into specific roleplay modes.

claims.claim: Online public servers are dominated by DarkRP and other roleplay modes, while other game modes can be difficult to find populated.

citations.review_text: Legendary and time-tested game. But, if u have no friends, its just boring, especially if u didn't know about workshop (or just don't want to download something). I recommend not to join online servers if ur newbie, because they are either a DarkRP with bad rules and BAD admins, where donating making you either a god or a scammed on real money person. Or.. Yes! You understand it right, there is NO, repeating, NO other servers except DarkRP, or whatever others RP servers. Like, they are either just a lobby, or a Zombie survival (1% chance to meet, and if so, there will be no people (maybe except admin and his friend)). But, if u have friend(s), this game is so damn good. You can play horror maps (or other story maps), quest maps like finding and collecting some things, or create a local room with mods, for example realistic weapons (Prop hunt - one of the bests) If u have no friends (online or.. you're just bad at searching), u can do some things too - ragdoll testing, torture maps, ALSO completing maps, testing physics (Gwater one of the bests), just play with bots (yes, there are mods for bots (even with custom voice chat)). But, if u do all of this, what ca you do also (and this will be interesting for you)? Maybe, playing with some war mods? Maybe do some scene for 4 hours again? Maybe TF2 or CS2 (and CS:GO global offensive!) sweps (Sweps - weapons or other things that you can hold in your hands)? Maybe, build (or download) a building that is builded via wood and destroy it? Maybe, Atom bombs with Gbombs? maybe.. Okay, so, you will say, of course — eithe- (neither), yep, if you have at least more than 50 hours, it will get kinda boring. You can try going into online servers, but, it doesn't change a lot. Good game, but recommend to grab it on sale, Have a great day mates
